Constitution binds over the 10x race: ¼-Kelly, 50 bps per-name risk, and survival before compounding — so no new risk this cycle.

glm.name: GLM
glm.thesis: Event-cluster caution under a hawkish curve: 2Y 4.39% above fed funds 3.63% (2s10s +41bp) prices policy tightening into Sep 15 CPI and the Sep FOMC while the post-NVDA AI complex de-grosses — hold the one structural steepener expression, cut thesis-less energy, keep ~93% in cash at the 3.63% front-end until the print resolves.
glm.justification: Note upfront: a 10x-in-12-months objective requires leverage and concentration the risk constitution prohibits, so this cycle optimizes survival and honest compounding, not the race. The research feed is two weeks stale (every item dated Aug 25–26; NVDA earnings already past) and positioning data failed to load, so no informational or behavioral edge is underwritable today — and with CPI (Sep 15) and FOMC (Sep 15–17) inside a week, long-vol event structures compute to negative EV at honest probabilities (P(QQQ −8% in 30d) ≈ 15–20% vs ~2% premium, with VXX already bid +1.8% today) while fresh shorts violate the 2× stop gap-risk rule into a binary print. I am selling XLE (−1.1%; no live thesis survives re-underwriting — oil sliding, SLB −2.5% today, OPEC+ already past) for a −4bps-of-NAV realized loss, and holding XLF as the single defensible structural expression: a curve pricing hikes from a 3.63% funds rate expands bank NIMs, and financials are the under-owned non-AI sleeve of a market whose gains are concentrated in two firms, making de-grossing rotation flows the marginal buyer. XLF at 7% is already at quarter-Kelly for p=0.55, so no add; the remaining ~93% sits in cash earning the front end, preserving optionality to underwrite post-CPI with fresh data rather than gamble on the print.
